num_vehicles: <int> Number of vehicles available in the dial-a-ride fleet.
num_users: <int> Number of users requesting transportation service.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum number of passengers that each vehicle can carry simultaneously.
maximum_ride_time: <int> Maximum time any user may spend aboard a vehicle from pickup to drop-off.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the service network, equal to 2 * num_users + 2 (one pickup and one drop-off per user, plus origin and destination depots).

nodes.node_id: <int> Unique identifier for this node, ranging from 0 (origin depot) to num_nodes - 1 (destination depot).
nodes.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of this node's location.
nodes.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of this node's location.
nodes.earliest_time: <float> Earliest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.latest_time: <float> Latest time at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.service_duration: <float> Time required to board or alight passengers at this node.
nodes.load: <int> Change in vehicle occupancy when visiting this node (positive at pickups, negative at drop-offs, zero at depots).
nodes.user_id: <int> Identifier of the user associated with this pickup or drop-off node (present only for pickup and dropoff nodes).
nodes.paired_node: <int> Node identifier of the corresponding drop-off node for a pickup, or the corresponding pickup node for a drop-off (present only for pickup and dropoff nodes).
nodes.request_type: <str> Whether this user's trip is 'outbound' (from home to a destination) or 'inbound' (from an origin back home) (present only for pickup and dropoff nodes).

maximum_route_duration: <int> Maximum total duration of any single vehicle's route from depot departure to depot return.
